title: Genesis 001 clears the 5% injury threshold—and no further

source.label: Locked held-out MLX validation

metricDefinitions.label: Functional recovery
metricDefinitions.definition: The organism remains localized, finishes with 40–130 mass units, retains 75–125% of its pre-injury mass, moves at least one cell after injury, and preserves at least 25% of pre-injury motion.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Recovered trials divided by 100 trials for each genotype and damage level.

caveats: Each point summarizes 100 trials across five unseen phases, four rotations, and five noise seeds.
This establishes robustness only for this simulator, genome, centered-disk lesion protocol, and 300-step observation window.
